comments.author: SpaceGhost
comments.body_html: Thanks for the mod! Are we able to add our own music by simply dropping the MP3 files in the \SPT\BepInEx\plugins\CustomMusic\music folder?

comments.author: Rosedrip
comments.body_html: Yes! You can add any music you want by doing that.
